FN-7BLUCV2-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 626
Committee: Economic Development and Sponsor: Representative Andy Whitt
Tourism
Analyst: Michael Russo Date: 03/18/2026
House Bill 626 as introduced could delay the receipt of ad valorem tax revenue growth
collected within certain tax increment districts (TIDs), that would otherwise be distributed to
state and local governments, as a results of allowing: (1) public entities to be reimbursed from
ad valorem tax revenues collected within TIDs for costs to acquire land or interest in land
forming a Major 21st Century Manufacturing Authority prior to the creation of a TID; (2) Major
21st Century Manufacturing Authorities to be located within a TID regardless of the size of the
TID; and (3) certain TIDs with a Major 21st Century Manufacturing Authority to have an
expanded lifetime of 5 additional years.
